title: Machine-readable result transport still requires host JSON
observed_need: Expose a stable result document to mncs-actions and future Forge without losing typed native values or structured diagnostics.
current_language_behavior: Native assertions, suite verdicts, and retained execution values are typed MNCS values. The Rust bootstrap CLI still serializes the external action-facing TestResult/CheckResult JSON and artifact paths.
why_insufficient: The complete cross-repository evidence protocol, including bounded strings/bytes and canonical JSON encoding, is not yet an application-level MNCS library surface.
minimal_reproducer: tools/mncs_test.py emits mncs.test-result/1 and mncs.check-result/1 after receiving the typed record from mncs-embed batch execution.
desired_direction: A versioned native serialization/protocol library for bounded structured results, with explicit text/bytes policy and lossless adapter projections.
workaround: The Rust toolchain performs the narrow structured projection. Python is limited to explicit Actions/compatibility transport and is not semantic authority for the native runner.
